buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to

minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of TROOPS COMFORT LIMITED, CMD, KANPUR A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA : OEMs/Manufacturers or their authorized dealers/ distributors/Sole Selling agents for t he tender store can only participate in the tender. Authorized dealers/ distributor/Sole selling agent of the OEM/ Manufacturer should submit the valid authorization certificate from the OEM along with Tender Enquiry. VENDOR REGISTRATION REQUEST : Applicable The procedures to be followed for registration of the firms for items other than t extile fabrics and garniture are as follows: a) The firm should submit the VRR application through TCL OVR portal for registrati on. b) The firm should upload all the necessary documents as per VRR application in cluding technical documents pertain to essential plant and machineries, inspectio n/testing facilities, process flow chart and specification (if applicable) required to manufacture the item. c) On receipt of VRR online application, technical particulars should be verified for evaluation of capacity of the firm by the user section and based on the recom mendations of user section and then QAM team, firm can be registered in OVR po rtal for the item. Further, if OEM is foreign vendors, the firm who is sole selling/stockist/dealer of f oreign vendors should submit their VRR application in TCL OVR portal alongwith th

e following documents for registration. i) The Firm should submit the online VRRF application for registration as “Authorised Dealer” for OEM of foreign vendors. ii) Authorised Dealer Notification from OEM in case of foreign vendors. iii) Genuineness of the Authorisation letter in OEM OFFICE LETTER HEAD issued to th e Factory. iv) Validity of the support for supply of Raw Material as Raw Material Assurance Certificate (RMAC) issued by OEM. v) Country of Origin certificate. Documents to be enclosed in the tender. 1. Standard Tender Enquiry of Procurement of Stores. (Annexure – 14) 2. Additional Terms & Conditions & Instructions of Tender (ATC). 3. Specification. 4. Compliance Statement: The firm should submit the filled & signed copies of compli ance statement along with the technical bid. 5. Compliance Statement for Specification: The firm shall provide Compliance statem ent for all the parameters during bid participation and submit the filled & signed copies of compliance statement along with the technical bid. . 6.
